reviews.cex-the-cfl-pumping-lemma-characterizes-: High risk because the repaired counterexample must simultaneously satisfy every quantifier of the ordinary pumping condition and remain non-context-free. I checked all leading-s cases for pumping length three: zero leading s, one leading s, at least two with a nonempty tail, and pure powers s^r. I also checked the non-context-freeness reduction: intersection with the regular language s a* b* c* gives sK, the PDA-DFA product preserves context-freeness, deleting s by homomorphism gives K, and the cited earlier theorem proves K={a^n b^n c^n} is not context free.
